info.title: Karibu ERP — implemented foundation API
info.description: Only implemented routes are specified. Reviewed stock gain/loss/full-reversal posting is available. Service-credit invoices support inert drafts and immutable valuation submission into independent review; no approval, exposure reservation, AR invoice posting, sales, purchasing, M-Pesa or fiscal posting is released. Runtime authorization, branch scope and database integrity checks are mandatory. Decimal values travel as strings. The full target domain catalog is in 03-api-security.md.
